meta.description: Quick answers about your account, wallet, teachers and courses, and privacy on Academia.

help.sub: Short answers to the most common questions. Can't find yours? Contact us.
help.empty: No results. Try another word or contact support.
help.contactSub: Our support team replies within 1–2 business days.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: On the sign-up page choose your role (student, teacher or parent), then fill in your name, email, phone and password.

items.q: I forgot my password — what now?
items.a: Email password recovery isn't available yet. Contact support, or change it from your account settings if you're signed in.

items.q: Do I stay signed in after closing the browser?
items.a: Yes, your session is kept until you sign out or it expires.

items.q: How do I top up my wallet?
items.a: Submit a top-up request with the amount, the transfer reference and a receipt image; an admin reviews it and the balance is added.

items.q: How does a teacher withdraw earnings?
items.a: From the Earnings page, submit a withdrawal request with your bank details; an admin reviews it and makes the transfer.

items.q: How do I find a teacher?
items.a: In the teacher directory, search by subject, grade, area, price and teaching mode, then open the profile to see availability.

items.q: What's the difference between a course and a private lesson?
items.a: A course is for a group with a fixed schedule and a listed price; a private lesson is with one teacher, based on their availability.

items.q: Can I cancel or reschedule a booked session?
items.a: Yes. From your dashboard you can cancel any eligible session before it starts, under the applicable cancellation policy, or request a reschedule — the teacher approves the new time before it's confirmed.
Their children's attendance and exam results, with read-only access.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Contact support and your account and its related data will be deleted.
